name: N360 App Release
description: Comprehensive mobile app release testing protocol with 19 verification phases and priority classification (P0 release blockers through P3 nice-to-have). Covers API health, auth flows, critical/emergency paths, navigation stability, permissions, watch apps, email templates, offline resilience, data integrity, security, build consistency, performance, accessibility, device compatibility, disaster recovery, compliance, end-to-end user journeys, and post-deploy verification. Built by Nucleus360 for App Store and Play Store submissions.
longDescription:
Ships **2 skills**, `app-release-testing` (Use before every App Store or Play Store submission), `post-deploy-verification` (Use immediately after any production deployment).

Installs with `claude plugin install n360-app-release@claude-community` from `JPVT1977/n360-marketplace` (`plugins/n360-app-release`).

A comprehensive mobile app release testing protocol for Claude Code. Built by Nucleus360 for teams shipping to the App Store and Play Store.
